messages:
jamie: Taking over the evening on-call (18:00 PST) — quick sync on INC-4789? page started ~17:10. Current status: mitigated but still in monitor. Who will be driver/comms for my shift?

incident-bot: INC-4789: high-latency errors on /generate — severity P2 — page sent to @eng-oncall at 17:12 — status: MONITORING — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-4789 — current owner: sarah (primary) / tony (backup)

sarah: I'm currently the driver, wrapping up post-mit checks. Will hand off driver to jamie unless any objections. Comms currently handled by emily.

jamie: OK I can take driver. @emily do you want to stay comms for the next 4 hours or hand off?

emily: I can stay until 22:00 then hand off comms to @nadeem. I'll keep the public status updated (status.redwood.com/inc-4789).

tony: Thanks. A couple notes: root cause looks like slow KV cache miss storm on redis-proxy-3. Runbook step 4 has patch to increase threadpool; dev infra already applied patch in canary. Scaling isn't needed now.

jamie: Noted. My immediate actions: subscribe to logs, watch latency graphs, set SLO alert to 10% increase. Any customer tickets open?

sarah: Two tickets from Acme and Lumen. Both reported >30s tail latencies. I've DM'd support with draft comms. @jamie I'll paste the draft.

sarah: Draft: 'We identified intermittent high latency impacting text generation calls. Mitigation applied; monitoring closely. We'll update in 30m or on change.'

jamie: Looks good. Add affected endpoints and workaround (use smaller batch sizes).

emily: Putting a short status on status page now. Also pinging account reps for Acme + Lumen.

incident-bot: Action required: Handoff checklist pending — confirm owner transfer with `ack-handoff INC-4789` in runbook. Last checkpoint at 17:58.

jamie: `ack-handoff` done. Taking driver. Setting calendar block for on-call till 02:00.

nadeem: I'll take comms at 22:00; please @me 15m beforehand.

jamie: Will do. @sarah any outstanding tasks or followups I should track?

sarah: Runbook items left: 6 (monitor KV miss rate), 8 (validate canary patch telemetry), 10 (postmortem owner). I've created a ticket INC-4789-PR for the postmortem; assigning to @sarah.

jamie: I'll own operational follow-ups during my shift; postmortem will be yours. I'll add notes to the ticket with timestamps of handoff.

tony: FYI, visibility: if latency creeps back up, fallback to model-variant b to reduce compute. Command (ops-only):

```
route set --variant b --until 02:00
```

jamie: Copy. I'll keep that as a last-resort. For now monitoring only.

emily: Also adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-4789 and the quick play: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98765

jamie: Thanks. Summary for the thread: driver=jamie (18:00-02:00), comms=emily (until 22:00) then nadeem (22:00-02:00), postmortem owner=sarah. No active mitigation needed; monitoring. I'll update if I take action.

incident-bot: INC-4789 handoff recorded: new driver jamie @ 18:02. Current severity: P2. Monitoring.

emily: :thumbsup:
